title: Edgeverse crosschain EVM Bridge
body:
**Original Proposal :** [Basic EVM Tools](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/8013-basic-evm-tools-for-edgeware-network)
**EVM Bridge Link :** [https://bridge.edgeverse.exchange](https://bridge.edgeverse.exchange)
**Tokens that are currently supported : **EDG, BUSD 
**Blockchains :** Edgeware, Binance Smart Chain 

   Recently, I mentioned EVM Bridge in my latest proposal (Basic EVM Tools). I am developing 2 different bridges for the Edgeware Network: the EVM Bridge and the Substrate Bridge. The EVM Bridge will increase the utility of EDG tokens. DEX listing, Staking, Borrowing/Lending, Farming etc.
I am not charging big money to make these EVM-based products. It’s not the original product, as we are copying popular products. I believe we can copy their work, but we can’t copy their success. We need this for my upcoming proposal at the IDO Launchpad. It will be a hybrid launchpad that supports multiple blockchains and real-world projects. I am writing a proposal once MVP is ready. Substrate bridge and substrate hybrid dex will be included with the IDO launchpad proposal. Substrate bridge is also a cross-chain bridge; it will be necessary to include Kabocha and other dotsama ecosystem projects in the new DEX. It will also support EVM chains. I will explain more about this with my next proposal. Let’s discuss the cross-chain EVM bridge now.



![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/6295af59-352a-4111-80af-3f52f290d4de.1670614846505)

**What is a cross-chain bridge?**
Just by looking at the words "cross,"  "chain,"  and "bridge,"  you can presume that a cross-chain bridge has something to do with enabling some sort of connection or transfer between different blockchains. Crosschain Bridge is a set of properly written code, including smart contracts, that enables users to transfer tokens, smart contract events or instructions, or even data, between different blockchains.
